data.body:
[operator-attested] LIVE-RUN EVIDENCE — the criterion this close was blocked on is now satisfied.

Ran a real `rebar review-plan d8ef-35a5-36e4-47c6 --ref HEAD` with the WORKTREE build (an editable
install of this branch, so the change under review is the code that executed). The run reached the
LLM tier — `"llm_ran": true` — and emitted a sidecar. The OBSERVED provider_provenance object:

    "provider_provenance": {
      "provider": "anthropic",
      "model": "anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6",
      "endpoint_host": null,
      "tier": "first_class",
      "capabilities": {
        "native_structured_output": false,
        "prompt_cache_style": "anthropic",
        "supports_thinking": true,
        "supports_temperature": true
      }
    }

`tier` is POPULATED and reads `first_class`, which matches the configured provider: this project runs
direct Anthropic with no custom base_url, and `provenance_for` sets `first_class` exactly when
base_url is absent (endpoint_host is correspondingly null). So the field is not merely present, it is
CORRECT for the configuration that produced it.

Compare the pre-fix measurement recorded in the GAP 5 comment on this ticket: the same command wrote
a sidecar with `model: claude-sonnet-4-6` and `provider_provenance: ABSENT`. Same command, same repo,
provenance now carried end to end through the real assembly path. That is the before/after this
criterion asked for.

WHY THE FIRST ATTEMPT AT THIS ATTESTATION DID NOT COUNT, recorded because it is a trap: I first ran
the review with the GLOBAL pipx build and got INDETERMINATE with `llm_ran: false`. That was NOT a
verdict on the change — the global build was two weeks stale and could not parse the dict-shaped
`activate` in .rebar/criteria_routing.json, so the LLM tier never ran and no provider was ever
resolved, which is precisely why provenance was absent. AGENTS.md's rule to run the repo checkout's
build rather than a stale global install is what this cost. Root-caused and repaired under bug 7cbe.

The verdict on d8ef itself was BLOCK on plan-quality grounds, which is irrelevant to this criterion —
what it attests is that a real gate run resolved a provider and stamped it into the signed payload.
Change 1154 is LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
